description: This file defines the CalendarProviderInstanceFactory class responsible for creating instances of calendar providers based on specified types. It contains methods to create provider instances, dynamically load provider classes from files, and handle errors related to class loading and type compliance.

classes.name: CalendarProviderInstanceFactory
classes.description: A factory class to instantiate calendar provider objects based on provided types, ensuring proper file loading and class inheritance.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a calendar provider instance if the provided type is enabled, setting up the connection, or returns null if disabled or if an error occurs.

methods.name: instantiateProvider
methods.description: Loads the provider class file, verifies class existence and inheritance, and returns a new instance or throws exceptions if validations fail.
